name: Vice Warden Morredh
speaker: entity:vice_warden_morredh
lines: Hm? I'm busy. Go bother one of the guards.
Hm? I don't have time for you, lowlife. There are bigger fish to fry.
What is it? You had better not be wasting my time. There's filth that requires scraping off the map.
Ha! Assist? I can't deny you've got guts. We've been tracking down a deserter by the name of Emar Vend. Intel suggests he's camping out somewhere on [Summer Isle](location:summer_isle).
That so? He's been capturing our soldiers and selling them off to [Etreans](aspect:etrean) as prisoners of war. If you can capture this coward, you'd be doing us a big favour.
You've impressed me, Chainwarden. What do you need?
Chain down those that oppose our justice. Should you find someone truly worthy of being ensnared by your chains, the Words will surely find you.
Justice will come to this world soon enough. When I'm Warden of the East, I'll make sure of that.
You dare show yourself before me? Not even groveling will change my mind about you, coward. You do not belong in a peaceful world.
